title: The carve-out is not bound to the expected PR shape
problem: The engine trusts any truthy `self_driving_review` value. It then skips the bot-author refusal and the draft prerequisite. The initial Inbox task does not confirm the expected App bot, a repo-native head, or the task repository. A task output that points at another PR can therefore receive the relaxed review path and a real approval.
suggestion: Verify the PR before the server writes `self_driving_review`. Check the expected App bot, repo-native head, task repository, and exact PR link. In this engine, require `context.get("self_driving_review") is True` and `pipeline.pr.author_is_bot`. Leave `self_driving` false when any check fails.
cluster_issue: Draft/bot gate relaxations in Pipeline are keyed only on self_driving, not coupled to pr.author_is_bot
